# Golden fixture provenance

These `*_generated.rs` files are byte-exact copies of schema-rust emission
goldens, kept pristine so they remain the acceptance oracle. They are READ-ONLY
inputs to this crate's round-trip harness; no edits are made to them.

Source repository: github.com/LiGoldragon/schema-rust
Source revision:   87de872dbc4ee124a6a1133ff520b594063304f5
Source directory:  tests/fixtures/

| fixture | source path |
| --- | --- |
| standard_newtype_impls_generated.rs | schema-rust/tests/fixtures/standard_newtype_impls_generated.rs |
| collections_generated.rs            | schema-rust/tests/fixtures/collections_generated.rs |
| spirit_generated.rs                 | schema-rust/tests/fixtures/spirit_generated.rs |
| runner_generated.rs                 | schema-rust/tests/fixtures/runner_generated.rs |

Each file is `// @generated by schema-rust` and was produced by the same
`prettyplease` formatting authority this crate re-uses on the encode side, which
is why per-item byte-exact round-trip is achievable for the in-subset items.
